title: Detection of methyl isocyanate (CH<SUB>3</SUB>NCO) in a solar-type protostar
question: Is methyl isocyanate (CH3NCO) present in the solar-type protostar IRAS16293-2422 B, what are its abundance and ratios to HNCO and NH2CHO, and how is it formed?

evidence.quote: a dust opacity of 0.009 cm$^{2}$ g$^{-1}$ (cite: ossenkopf94)
By assuming an isotopic ratio $^{12}$C/$^{13}$C=68 (cite: milam05)
By assuming an isotopic ratio $^{16}$O/$^{18}$O = 500 (Wilson & Rood 1994)
using the information from the Jet Propulsion Laboratory (cite: pick98) and the Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy spectral catalogs (cite: mull05)

recipe.method: Spectrum extracted from each datacube with circular aperture ~1.6" centred on IRAS16293 B

recipe.goal: Identify lines and fit LTE CH3NCO
recipe.method: MADCUBAIJ synthetic LTE spectra compared with observed to derive Tex and N

recipe.goal: Derive H2 column density and abundance
recipe.method: Optically thin dust continuum at 232 GHz
assumptions: Optically thin dust, kappa 0.009 cm2/g, gas-to-dust 100, Tdust=Tex=110 K

recipe.goal: HNCO and NH2CHO columns via isotopologues
recipe.method: LTE fits of HNC18O (Tex fixed 110 K) and NH2 13CHO (Tex 75 K), scaled by isotopic ratios
Three-phase UCL_CHEM gas-grain model with added CH3NCO, HNCO routes
key_parameters: nH 5e8 cm-3, T 10 to 110 K over 1e5 yr

evidence.quote: CH$_3$NCO/HNCO and CH$_3$NCO/NH$_2$CHO column density ratios of $\sim$0.08
a predicted abundance for CH$_3$NCO of \[CH$_3$NCO\]=$6.0\times10^{-10}$

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version and imaging parameters (weighting, robust, cell, image size, deconvolver)
Line-free channels used for continuum subtraction
Per-dataset imaging details and which datasets cover which lines
MADCUBAIJ fitting settings (parameter priors, velocity, fit method)
Whether catalogs entries (JPL vs CDMS) used for CH3NCO
Details of chemical model grid, best-fit age and parameter sampling
missing_for_reproduction: Model grid and best-fit procedure details
score_reason: Public data and clear LTE recipe, but imaging parameters and fit settings absent.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, LTE fit with numeric results, though imaging details must be reconstructed.
